newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B index slips at noon on crackdown talk.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B index slips at noon on crackdown talk.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index edged lower by midday on Thursday, reversing morning gains, due to continued rumours that the securities authorities are planning measures to cool down the markets, analysts said.
The foreign currency B share index slipped 0.24 points or 0.14 percent to 170.50 on turnover of HK$93.8 million.
The domestic currency A index gained 1.38 points or 0.28 percent to 501.41 on turnover of 5.6 billion yuan.
"Today's trading was very volatile, especially after non-official media reported rumours of various moves to crack down on the market," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
China may soon ban several major brokerages from carrying out securities trading on their own accounts as punishment for irregular activities, brokers said.
At least four brokerages, including Shenyin & Wanguo Securities, China's largest, may be barred from trading for themselves, they said.
"We have heard that our own trading licence may be stripped for half a year," said a trader at one of the brokerages rumoured to be facing punishment.
"The B index rose in early morning on bargain-hunting, but investors quickly abandoned their positions as crackdown rumours heated up," an analyst at J&A Securities said.
Brokers also said Zhou Daojiong, the chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the country's top securities watchdog, may step down soon.
Officials at the CSRC declined to comment.
In the B share market, Hubei Sanonda Co Ltd 2553.SZ closed at noon at HK$5.62 after its first morning of trading, compared with an issue price of HK$3.48.
"I am not sure if this is a fair value for the stock judging by the volatile market sentiment," the Guotai analyst said.
Analysts said they expect Sanonda's B shares to slip back to between HK$4.0 and HK$5.0 in the short term.
The pesticide maker's B share issue was 10 times oversubscribed last month, analysts said.
